chapter.skyabyss.abyss_v2.salt.title: The Salt Layer
chapter.skyabyss.abyss_v2.storm.title: The Storm Layer

cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.bone.hero1: The fire is still warm. ...Someone waited here for others to return.
cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.bone.hero2: Three hollows in the north seal. Places for marks.
cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.salt.hero1: The air is heavy. Every breath settles salt in my lungs.
cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.salt.hero2: Another camp. The same people as above.
cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.storm.hero1: The copper in the walls is humming. Not thunder. ...A heartbeat.
cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.storm.hero2: From the three paths, the beat comes back out of step.
cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.ash.hero1: Light thins out fast here. The dark likes this place.
cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.ash.hero2: Footprints in the ash. All going in. None coming back.
cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.heart.hero1: It is beating. Through my soles, into my bones.
cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.heart.hero2: The heart is ahead. ...And the thing that watches it.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.teller.bone_1: Storyteller: "The bone layer. Where the titans' beats first fall and pool."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.teller.bone_2: Storyteller: "The excavation party that went before split three ways here. Three marks. ...Keep your light alive."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.teller.salt_1: Storyteller: "The salt layer. The deeper you go, the heavier you get. Weight means the heart is near."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.teller.salt_2: Storyteller: "A surveyor stayed behind here. Mapmakers keep drawing the way home to the very end."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.teller.storm_1: Storyteller: "The storm layer. Lightning here falls in time with the heart."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.teller.storm_2: Storyteller: "Listen to the beat. There is only ever one true heartbeat."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.teller.ash_1: Storyteller: "The ash layer. A nest of things that eat light."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.teller.ash_2: Storyteller: "The captain got this far. ...Only he knows what lies beyond."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.teller.heart_1: Storyteller: "The heart chamber. The warden uses light, weight, the beat and the dark. The layer lords taught you each one."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.mark_mate: %1$s took the %2$s. Your mark glows with it.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.marks_all: All three marks. Go to the seal north of the camp.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.mark_guarded.n: Bone flutes swarm the altar. Clear the nest first.
The moths' charge keeps your hand off the altar. Clear the nest.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.mark_guarded.w: The altar is cold. Come down with Roku and secure this resting place.
The altar is cold. Come down with Roku and secure this resting place.
The altar is cold. Come down with Roku and secure this resting place.
The altar is cold. Come down with Touya and secure this resting place.
The altar is cold. Come down with Touya and secure this resting place.
The altar is cold. Come down with Touya and secure this resting place.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.gate_closed: The seal's hollows are cold. Not enough marks (%s/3).
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.gate_open: The three marks flare and the seal lets you through.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.gate_back: You pass back through the seal to the camp.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.gate_closed_es: The bars stay down. You have not brought %s this far yet.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.gate_back_b: You pass back through the bars onto the descent.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.back: You haul yourself up the chain to this layer's camp.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.descend_closed: The chain is taut and will not move. The lord of this hall is still watching.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.descend: You ride the chain down to the next layer.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.ascend: You haul yourself up the chain to the camp above.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.start.s: Roku: "I'll run Hayase's line down to the lord's hall. A mark for the way home. ...Keep ahead of me."
Roku: "I'll stop at each resting place. Clear it and I'll walk on. Don't get too far ahead."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.wait_yo: Roku: "Wait. I can't go down alone."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.wp.salt: Roku: "The crust is thin. It'll break under me. Tie the line to the stake across. With the weight art, the crust will hold you."
Roku: "There's a lamp on the rim above. Light it and the ladder comes down. The salt wind only carries the light."
Roku: "I'll drive the anchor here. Guard my back while I count forty-five. ...The white shell moved."
Salt husks crawl out of the cracks. They are going for Roku.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.worn.sa: Roku: "Agh... I can't hold much longer."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.fail.sa: Roku went down. ...When he comes to, you are back at the last resting place. Roku: "Sorry. Once more."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.secured: The line is tied. Roku: "Right, laying the planks. ...I'm across. Next."
The ladder drops. Roku: "Climbing. ...Telling myself not to look down."
The anchor rings. Somewhere, the crust underfoot starts to crack. Roku: "Done. ...Bad. The collapse is coming."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.arm.sal: Roku: "Come close. When we're together, we run. Beat the collapse to the bars before the lord's hall."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.lead.sa: Roku: "Hurry! The collapse is catching up!"
The floor gives way. Your feet sink. Forward!
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.escape_: The collapse swallowed you. ...You wake by the anchor. Roku: "Again. Don't stop this time."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.done.sa: Roku: "We made it...! The line runs all the way here. Now Hayase's way home is joined up."
Roku: "Past the bars is the lord's hall. I'll watch the line from here. Go."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.after.s: Roku: "You did it. ...I'll follow the line back to camp and tell Hayase."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.home.sa: Roku follows the line back up to the camp.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.talk_fi: Roku: "Hear Hayase out first. The way down can wait till then."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.start.a: Touya: "I'll guide you down the ash road. ...As far as the hall before the heart. A captain's last job."
Touya: "Things that eat light come out here. Don't let my lamp go out. I stop at each resting place; clear it and I walk."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.wait_yo: Touya: "...Don't leave me. I'm done going down alone."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.wp.ash_: Touya: "Too dark to see the trail. Your light art will show the embers. Light the fire at the exit; I'll follow its glow."
Touya: "The seal of three arts. Light, weight, the beat, one after another. I'll hold the lamp up."
Touya: "The ember keeper's ground. We don't go on until it's cleared. ...Here it comes."
Soot children well up from the ash, swarming Touya's lamp.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.wave.as: Another swarm of soot children rises from the ash.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.fail.as: Touya's lamp went out. ...You find yourselves back at the last resting place. Touya: "Not yet. Again."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.secured: The exit fire catches. Touya: "I see it. ...Following the trail."
The seal crumbles. Touya: "All three arts... I never could."
The ember keeper returns to ash. Far off, something draws a breath. Touya: "The lord has woken. The dark wave is coming."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.arm.ash: Touya: "Close in. When we're together, we run. Reach the bars before the dark takes us. Light art pushes it back."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.run.ash: Touya: "Run! Keep the light behind you!"
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.lead.as: Touya: "Don't fall behind! The dark is coming!"
The dark closes in. Your breath burns. Cast light, or run!
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.escape_: The dark swallowed you. ...You wake in the ember ground. Touya: "Again. Keep the light alive."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.done.as: Touya: "Past the bars is the Lord of Eaten Light. When the dark comes, make your own light. Go."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.after.a: Touya: "You got past it. ...Below is the heart. I'll wait at camp for you to come back. Like Mio does."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.home.as: Touya walks back up through the ash to the camp, alone.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.joined: You join %s on the way down. Secure each resting place to earn its mark.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.stake_d: You tie the line to the stake.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.stake_n: There is no one to run a line for. Come with Roku.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.beacon_: The lamp is cold. ...Light it when you come down with your companion.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.escort.push: Your light drives the dark back.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.hint.bone: Three braziers, all stone cold. ...The light art might kindle them all at once.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.hint.salt: The floor is a white crust. It rings thin under each step. If you were lighter, it might hold.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.hint.well: A salt wind rises from the bottom of the well. If you were light enough, it could carry you.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.hint.storm: Three doors. Something beats behind one of them. The heartbeat art could tell which.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.hint.hall: The hall floor is scorched. Lightning falls on the beat. Keep clear of the red rings.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.hint.maze: Pitch black. Only inside the light art's glow do the ember tracks show.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.hint.ash: Three pedestals before the sealed door, marked light, weight and beat. Use all three in turn...
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.door_bone_open: All three braziers flare together. The bone door beyond crumbles away.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.hidden_open: Where the light touched, the wall came apart. There is a small room behind it.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.doors_heard: There is the heartbeat. ...From behind the door where the heart motes drift.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.door_true: A steady heartbeat beyond the door. The way goes on.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.seal_open: The three pedestals light in turn, and the sealed door collapses into ash.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.find.hidden_bo: A sooty lantern in the chest, branded with the excavation party's mark. ...The one Mio was looking for.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.find.frag_salt: A map fragment. Under the salt floor, in a neat hand: "Pit is shallow. Crust breaks under weight."
A map fragment. Beside the well: "Wind blows up. Make yourself light."
A map fragment. Across the territory, in heavy strokes: "Don't."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.nest_wake.nest: The bone flute nest starts to wail. A swarm is coming.
Every moth in the nest charges at once.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.nest_clear.nes: The nest falls silent. The mark on the altar is in reach.
The wings go still. The charge drains from the altar.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.terr_wake.terr: The lord of this ground opens its shell.
The ember keeper rises out of the ash.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.terr_clear.ter: The white shell keeper breaks apart. A mark glows inside the shell.
The ember keeper returns to ash. The altar fire gutters.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.ambush_bone: The bones in the wall niches stand up.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.ambush_bridge: Bone pickers crawl up onto both ends of the bridge.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.shadow_1: Someone is sitting behind the door. ...The same build as you.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.shadow_2: The shadow looks up. "Still going down?"
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.shadow_gone: The shadow unravels and is still. Tell Shizu.
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_bone: Ribs lord: light lamps, fight in light
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_wake.bone: At the back of the hall, a heap of ribs stands up.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_teach.bon: The lamps light with a right-click. Outside the light, your blade glances off. ...Is the warden below like this too?
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_fall.bone: The Lord of Ribs collapses. In the light, even things of the dark can be cut.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_dim.bone: Your blade will not bite outside the light.
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_salt: Lord of White Shells: leave the red rings
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_wake.salt: A mass of white shell drops from the ceiling.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_teach.sal: Weight falls inside the red rings. Under the weight art, it will not crush you.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_fall.salt: The Lord of White Shells cracks open. Weight can be dodged, or shrugged off if you are light.
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_storm: Beat-mimic lord: hit the one with a pulse
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_wake.stor: The copper walls ring together and the hall fills with a heartbeat.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_teach.sto: It splits into copies. Only the real one beats. The heartbeat art will outline the true one.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_fall.stor: The Lord of Mimicked Beats falls silent. There is only ever one true heartbeat.
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_ash: Light-eater lord: cast light after dark
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_wake.ash: The lights go out one by one, and a mouth opens in the dark.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_teach.ash: When the dark wave comes, every light dies, and the lord cannot be cut in the dark. Light it with your art.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_fall.ash: The Lord of Eaten Light dissolves into the dark. Even when darkness comes, you can make your own light.
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.lord_dim.ash: Your blade cannot reach it in the dark. Use the light art.
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.flash_guard_: Guard the light. Stand inside the red ring
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.flash_weight: Leave the red rings, or endure with weight
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.flash_beat: The one with the heartbeat is real
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.flash_dark: Blades miss in the dark. Cast light
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.dark_coming: The lord howls three times. The dark wave is coming.
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.warden_p1: Light lamps; hit the warden in the light
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.warden_snuff: Guard the light. It comes to snuff a lamp
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.warden_p2: The one with the heartbeat is real
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.warden_crush: Red rings crush: leave, or bear weight
objective.skyabyss.abyss_v2.warden_p3: After the dark wave, cast light
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.bone_0: Party ledger: "The capital's wells pulse every night. At the Whale Chasers' Guild's request, six of us go down to find the source. — Captain Touya"
Ledger, continued: "Three hollows in the north seal, for marks it seems. We split three ways. Mio keeps the lights."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.bone_1: Lectern page: "The brazier room. The wall says to light all three at once and the door opens. ...The writing looks like ours."
Page, continued: "The captain says I imagine it. But someone came before us and cut these marks."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.bone_2: Lectern page: "The bone flutes in the nest never stopped. Gorou was bitten. He says it is shallow."
Page, continued: "We got the mark. On the way back we found a straight path to the camp. The bars opened from the far side."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.bone_3: Lectern page: "The rib bridge, one at a time. The pit is shallow; a ladder leads back. Roku fell. Three times."
Page, continued: "Before the lord's hall, Mio's lamp was blown out. She said she would go back for a light."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.salt_0: Hayase's ledger: "The deeper, the heavier. Climbing is worse. This is the weight of something vast below us."
Ledger, continued: "The captain said: bring a shard of the heart to the capital and the wells will stop shaking. I nodded."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.salt_1: Lectern page: "The salt crust floor. Heavy things fall through. We left every pack and went across light."
Page, continued: "My map broke here along with the crust. The pieces scattered down the road."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.salt_2: Lectern page: "The wind in the well carries only the light. Shizu went up first and dropped a rope."
Page, continued: "The rope has snapped now. ...From here, I doubt I will ever climb back up."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.salt_3: Lectern page: "The white shell keeper's ground. It keeps the mark shut in its shell. Gorou's wound has started to harden white."
Page, continued: "The salt lord drops weight on you. Inside its ring, my bones creaked."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.storm_: Shizu's ledger: "Lightning falls on a beat. Counting it, it is the heart's pace. This is the layer where you hear the heart."
Ledger, continued: "I argued with the captain. The heart is no treasure, I said. It is more like a promise someone made."
Lectern page: "Three doors. Behind a wrong one sat a shadow just like one of us. Gorou spoke to it and did not come back."
Page, continued: "Only behind the true door is there a heartbeat. We would have known, if we had listened."
Lectern page: "The thunder hall. The red ring glows, then the strike. We counted beats and ran one stretch at a time."
Page, continued: "Nagi stumbled. A beat too late. ...The lightning does not wait."
Lectern page: "The mimic lord splits into copies. A copy burst when struck and burned Nagi's arm."
Page, continued: "Only the captain and Roku went on down. I decided to wait here for whoever climbs up."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.ash_0_: Touya's ledger: "Only Roku and I made it this far. I sent Roku back up. A porter's job is to carry the way home."
Ledger, continued: "Something here eats light. Lights wither fast. I will scatter my notes so no one follows."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.ash_1_: Captain's notes (1): "Through the ash maze. Only in the light could I see the ember trail. Someone had blazed it before me."
Notes, continued: "I reached the heart chamber. Cold, yet beating. I set my blade to it to cut a shard."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.ash_2_: Captain's notes (2): "The warden came. I could not see it. Only in the light did a shape of ribs appear."
Notes, continued: "It was not guarding the heart. It was watching so the world would not come loose from it."
message.skyabyss.abyss_v2.journal.ash_3_: Captain's notes (3): "The warden spoke. 'It is not enough yet.' The voice was not mine."
Notes, continued: "It was your voice. ...Yours, the one reading this."
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.bone_camp.jour: The first layer of the abyss. A lamp keeper of the excavation party stayed at the camp. Hear her out.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.bone_camp.talk: Talk to Mio the lamp keeper
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.bone_marks.jou: The lamp keeper said the north seal needs three marks. Search the three paths.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.bone_lord.jour: Beyond the seal: the Lord of Ribs. Light the lamps and strike in the light.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.salt_camp.jour: A surveyor sits slumped at the salt layer camp.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.salt_marks.jou: You learned the weight art. Roku runs Hayase's line down to the lord's hall. The salt crust, the salt wind well, the white shell ground: secure all three, then beat the collapse to the bars.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.salt_lord.jour: The Lord of White Shells. Weight falls inside the red rings.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.salt_lord.defe: Defeat the Lord of White Shells
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.storm_camp.jou: At the storm layer camp, an apothecary waits for someone.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.storm_marks.jo: You learned the heartbeat art. The heartbeat doors, the thunder hall, the moth nest. Gather three marks.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.storm_lord.jou: The Lord of Mimicked Beats. The one with the heartbeat is real.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.storm_lord.def: Defeat the Lord of Mimicked Beats
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.ash_camp.journ: The party's captain is at the ash layer camp.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.ash_marks.jour: Light withers fast here. Guard Touya's lamp on the way down. The ash maze, the three-arts seal, the ember ground: pass all three, then outrun the dark wave to the bars.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.ash_lord.journ: The Lord of Eaten Light. After the dark wave, make light with your art.
quest.skyabyss.main_abyss.ash_lord.defea: Defeat the Lord of Eaten Light
quest.skyabyss.ch5.lamp_keeper.title: The Party Lantern
quest.skyabyss.ch5.lamp_keeper.summary: Find the party lantern Mio lost.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.lamp_keeper.find.jour: The lantern lies behind a wall that crumbles only in light.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.lamp_keeper.find.take: Shine the light art on a wall in the east hall
quest.skyabyss.ch5.lamp_keeper.return.jo: Go back and tell Mio the Lamp Keeper.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.lamp_keeper.return.ta: Talk to Mio the Lamp Keeper
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_survivor_bon: ...Footsteps. Are you back? Captain?
No. A stranger. I'm Mio, lamp keeper of the capital's excavation party. I keep this fire until everyone comes back.
To pass the north seal you need three marks. Three paths. The party split three ways here. ...Don't let your light die.
Understood
The Lord of Ribs blew my light out and I dropped the party lantern somewhere. The captain said some walls crumble only in light.
If you have the light art, shine it on the walls of the hall on the east path. ...Will you bring it back if you find it?
I'll do it
Later
That...! The brand is ours. Thank you.
Somehow I feel the light reaches the ones who went down now. Keep it. I have this fire.
Seven of us. Captain Touya, Hayase the surveyor, Shizu the apothecary, Roku the porter, Gorou, Nagi. And me.
The wells in the capital pulsed every night, so we came to find the source. ...No one who went down has come back up.
Ask about something else
You beat the Lord of Ribs? It couldn't be cut outside the light. The captain said the warden below might be the same.
Ask about something else
Stay by the fire. It's warm.
Is something wrong?
Ask about the excavation party
Talk about the lord
Leave
quest.skyabyss.ch5.surveyor_map.title: The Torn Map
quest.skyabyss.ch5.surveyor_map.summary: Gather Hayase's map fragments along the salt descent.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.surveyor_map.find.jou: One fragment lies in a chest at each resting place on the way down.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.surveyor_map.return.j: Go back and tell Hayase the Surveyor.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_survivor_sal: Oh... from above, are you. I am Hayase, the party's surveyor. Come closer. Forgive me for not standing.
My body is too heavy to climb now. The abyss grows heavier the deeper you go. It is the weight of something immense below.
The captain said a shard of the heart would stop the wells shaking. I nodded along.
The way here is a single long descent. Roku will run my line down to the lord's hall, as a mark for the way home. ...Keep him safe. He waits at the north mouth.
Understood
My map broke on the salt crust and scattered. One piece at each of the three resting places on the way down. It was a map of the way home.
Would you gather them? Even if I can't go home, so that someone can.
I'll do it
Later
Yes, this line. My hand. ...Now the way up joins together.
Take this in exchange. A compass that points to where you last fell. When the weight is beating you, remember the weight art.
The bite Gorou took in the nest hardened white, and he could not move past the salt layer. Shizu held his hand to the end.
Ask about something else
You cracked the shell lord. Its weight you dodge, or go light and let it pass. The warden will drop weight on you too, surely.
Ask about something else
Anything you wish to ask?
Ask about the map
Ask about the excavation party
Talk about the lord
Leave
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shadow_rest.title: The Shadow Behind the Door
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shadow_rest.summary: Lay to rest the shadow behind the heartbeat doors.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shadow_rest.done: "Shadows wear the shape of those who never came home."
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shadow_rest.find.jour: Behind a wrong door sits a shadow much like you.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shadow_rest.find.rest: Defeat the shadow behind the door
quest.skyabyss.ch5.shadow_rest.return.jo: Go back and tell Shizu the Apothecary.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_survivor_sto: Stop. ...Breathe. Yes, one heartbeat. Good. You're not a shadow.
I'm Shizu, the party's apothecary. Lightning here falls on the heart's beat. Count it and you'll know when to run.
The captain and I argued here. The heart is no treasure, I said. More like a promise someone made. ...Gather the three marks.
Behind a wrong heartbeat door there was a shadow just like Gorou. Nagi spoke to it, and was never right after.
Lay that shadow to rest. It's probably someone who came here before. ...It might even be you.
It sleeps? ...Thank you. Shadows wear the shape of those who never made it home.
Take some medicine. The heartbeat art can mend the people around you too.
Nagi fell a beat behind in the thunder hall. Only the captain and Roku went down. I chose to wait for whoever comes up.
You silenced the mimic lord. The true heartbeat is only ever one. The warden's shadows will be the same.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.captain_pages.title: The Scattered Notes
quest.skyabyss.ch5.captain_pages.summary: Read Captain Touya's notes along the ash descent.
quest.skyabyss.ch5.captain_pages.find.jo: Three notebooks: at the maze mouth, the seal room and the ember ground.
Go back and tell Captain Touya.
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_survivor_ash: ...So you came. Straight through the ash. You don't get lost, do you.
Touya, captain of the excavation party. I left everyone above. Only Roku I sent home. A porter carries the way back.
If you want the heart chamber, you go through the ash road. ...I'll guide you. And what lies beyond, I wrote in my notes. Scattered, so no one would follow.
I'll wait at the north mouth. Guard my lamp. Three resting places, then the hall of the Lord of Eaten Light.
Understood
Three notebooks, one down each of the ash paths. ...Read them and come back. If you still go down after that, I won't stop you.
I'll do it
Later
You read them. ...I tried to cut a shard from the heart. Telling myself it was for the capital.
The warden doesn't guard the heart. It watches so the world doesn't come loose from its anchor. And that voice... it was yours.
Light, weight, the beat, the dark. The layer lords taught you each one. Use all of them. ...Go.
Is Mio still keeping the fire? Hayase with his map, Shizu waiting for someone. ...They're all too good at waiting.
Ask about something else
Past the Lord of Eaten Light too. When darkness falls, you can make your own light. Don't forget that before the warden.
Ask about something else
...What.
Ask about the notes
Ask about the excavation party
Talk about the lord
Leave
dialogue.skyabyss.attendant_abyss_porter: Hey. Been a while since I saw a living face. Roku, the porter. The captain told me to go home, and I sat down halfway.
You're carrying abyss junk, right? I'll swap you food for it. Carrying the way home is my job.
Pleasure. Say hi to Mio when you're back up.
cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.warden.hero1: The warden is coming apart. ... And still, the heart beats.
cinematic.skyabyss.abyss_v2.warden.hero2: Above me, ribs. All this time I was inside the chest of something vast.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_near.title: The Moon Draws Near
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_near.summary: The anchor is still loose. Look up at the moon at night.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_near.done: The moon's tale continues in chapter six.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_near.look.journ: At the bottom of the abyss you learned the anchor is still loose. The storyteller said the moon is coming closer. Go outside at night and look up at it.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_near.look.moon: Look up at the moon outside at night
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_near.tell.journ: The moon was bigger than the last time you looked, close enough to count the marks on its face. Tell the storyteller.
quest.skyabyss.main_moon_near.tell.talk: Tell the storyteller about the moon
message.skyabyss.moon_near.seen: The moon is big. ... Much nearer than the last time you looked. You could almost count the marks on its face.
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch6_moon:
Big, wasn't it. ... My eyes say so too.
When the anchor slackens, the moon leans in. The counting song's sixth verse: "the round lid of the sky."
dialogue.skyabyss.storyteller.ch6_moon2:
I never heard the sky song to its end. ... But if anyone knows it, it would be the moon.
Get ready. The next tale goes up into the sky.
